title: GitHub trend: LiveKit Agents builds realtime voice and video assistants
friendlyTitle: LiveKit Agents helps developers build voice and video assistants
summary: LiveKit Agents is a server-side framework for realtime, programmable voice and multimodal assistants. It lets developers combine speech recognition, language models, text-to-speech, realtime APIs, telephony, and video components.
friendlySummary: This framework connects speech, AI models, phone calls, and video for assistants that respond in real time.
whyItMatters: Use it to prototype or deploy assistants that need to hear, speak, see, or join calls with low latency. Its broad integration layer makes it useful for testing different model and speech-provider combinations without rebuilding the full media stack.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to build a phone helper, voice support agent, meeting assistant, or other live conversation tool.
